description: Checks if there is an error in the formula in the first argument. The function returns the specified value if the formula returns the *#N/A* error value, otherwise returns the result of the formula.

params.description: The value, expression, or reference that is checked for an error.
params.name: arg1

params.description: The value to return if the formula evaluates to the *#N/A* error value.
params.name: arg2

signature: IFNA(arg1: ApiRange | ApiName | number | string | boolean, arg2: ApiRange | ApiName | number | string | boolean): number | string | boolean
